briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 push AGI frontier amid escalating compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 11 new models this month as the AGI race intensifies between US and Chinese players. Total quarterly funding hit $11.9B with heavy focus on inference infrastructure.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with 4.2T parameters while xAI launched Grok-4 achieving new benchmarks on agentic tasks. DeepSeek-R2 and Meta's Llama-4 follow closely behind.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent environments including automotive and BCI.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA shipped 2.1M H200 GPUs this quarter as Microsoft and Google expand data centers in Texas and Arizona. TSMC reports 3nm yield improvements benefiting custom AI ASICs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will any lab achieve coherent long-horizon agentic behavior before 2027?
